    target.u_requested_for_email = name.replace(" ", ".") + "@example.com";
  }

(function transformEntry(source, target) {
   var dateStr = (source.u_when_needed + '').trim();

   if (!dateStr || dateStr == 'undefined') {
      return;
   }

   var parts = dateStr.split("/");
   if (parts.length !== 3) {
      gs.warn('Date non reconnue : ' + dateStr);
      return;
   }

   var month = ('0' + parts[0]).slice(-2);
   var day = ('0' + parts[1]).slice(-2);
   var year = parts[2];
   if (year.length === 2) {
      year = "20" + year;
   }

   var gdt = new GlideDateTime();
   gdt.setValue(year + '-' + month + '-' + day + ' 00:00:00');
   target.u_when_needed = gdt;
})(source, target);]]></script><source_table>u_historic_needit_data</source_table><sys_class_name>sys_transform_map</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-01 13:25:08</sys_created_on><sys_id>fe1e646353eb0310c789f7e0a0490e83</sys_id><sys_mod_count>9</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Import Historic NeedIt Data</sys_name><sys_package display_value="NeedIt" source="x_58872_needit">6ead8e780f603200cd674f8ce1050ed1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="NeedIt">6ead8e780f603200cd674f8ce1050ed1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_transform_map_fe1e646353eb0310c789f7e0a0490e83</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-05 12:15:25</sys_updated_on><target_table>x_58872_needit_needit</target_table></sys_transform_map></record_update>
